invariants_created: Every HTTP/1.1 request must precede its corresponding response in the message stream.
If a 401 Unauthorized response is received, the subsequent request to the same resource should include an Authorization header.
If a 3xx redirect response (e.g., 301) is received with a Location header, the client should issue a new GET request to the specified URI.
A HEAD request must not be followed by a response body, although headers are returned.
Persistent connections allow multiple request-response pairs over a single TCP connection until Connection: close is sent.
HTTP_REQUEST.Host: Mandatory in all HTTP/1.1 requests to identify the target virtual host.
HTTP_REQUEST.Content-Length: Required if the request contains a body (e.g., POST, PUT, PATCH) and Transfer-Encoding is not used.
HTTP_REQUEST.Authorization: Required in requests following a 401 Unauthorized response to access protected resources.
HTTP_RESPONSE.Location: Must be present in 3xx redirect responses to indicate the new resource URI.
HTTP_RESPONSE.Body: Must be absent in HEAD responses and 204 No Content responses.
